sources.title: qwen2.5:0.5b-instruct/system - ollama.com
sources.snippet: The model supports up to 128K tokens and has multilingual support. Qwen2.5 models are pretrained on Alibaba's latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18 trillion tokens.
